description: Conversion from MCP Description 0.8.0 to 0.9.0 (Proposal 0028). Every incompatibility that can make a valid 0.8.0 document invalid under 0.9.0 is a rule.

rewrites.summary: Point $schema at the target schema when the source declares one.

rules.summary: Tool Annotations are closed in 0.9.0 (Proposal 0027); properties MCP does not define are not allowed.
Resource Annotations, including those on content blocks, are closed in 0.9.0 (Proposal 0027).
Client capability requirements accept only capabilities MCP defines in 0.9.0 (Proposal 0027).
The completion object of a completion example result is closed in 0.9.0 (Proposal 0026).
Every Resource Template uriTemplate is checked against RFC 6570 in 0.9.0, also without examples.
Resource size and example ttlMs are integers in 0.9.0 (Proposal 0029); rounding would change the value, so no fix is offered.

fixes.summary: Remove the member at the blocker path.
Move client requirement <name> to experimental.<name>, adding experimental when absent; not applicable when experimental.<name> exists.
